nd43d9a50b7.headline: All areas in city region will see council tax go up next month
nd43d9a50b7.summary: All councils in the Liverpool City Region have voted to raise council tax starting next month.
nd43d9a50b7.why: Local tax increases affect household disposable income and regional economic conditions in the UK.

nf4f6bc9a17.headline: Saudi Central Bank Extends Deferred Payment Program
nf4f6bc9a17.summary: Saudi Arabia's Central Bank extended a deferred payment program until June 30 to support private sector financing amid pandemic impacts.
nf4f6bc9a17.why: The central bank's measures aim to bolster Saudi Arabia's economy by supporting private sector liquidity and credit availability.

nba8f1fd0df.headline: LIC's authorised capital to be hiked to Rs 25,000 crore to facilitate listing
nba8f1fd0df.summary: LIC plans to increase its share capital to facilitate a possible stock market listing, as per proposed amendments to the Life Insurance Corporation Act.
nba8f1fd0df.why: LIC is India's largest state-owned life insurer, and its listing could significantly impact the country's financial markets and investor sentiment.
nba8f1fd0df.why_moved: LIC's move to increase capital and list on the stock exchange could boost investor confidence in Indian financial markets.

ndf2e8c998b.headline: FPIs turn net sellers, pull out Rs 5,156 crore in March so far
ndf2e8c998b.summary: Foreign portfolio investors pulled out a net Rs 5,156 crore from Indian equities and debt segments between March 1-5.
ndf2e8c998b.why: FPI flows impact India's capital markets and currency stability, influencing investor sentiment and borrowing costs.
ndf2e8c998b.why_moved: FPI withdrawals reduce demand for Indian assets, potentially leading to market declines and currency depreciation.
